run.title: S29 · Sequential Spanish audio benchmark
run.execution: Strictly sequential: one model at a time, one complete WAV request at a time; no queue, batching, concurrency, or cross-recording context.

evaluator.reason: GPT-6 Astra High is unavailable from the installed app-server client; the current sprint was already at its 49% conservative quota boundary, so no additional model-consuming evaluator task was launched.
evaluator.input_scope: 247 deduplicated non-exact reference/prediction pairs plus source intent labels; no audio and no latency used for grading

combined_runs.title: S30 · Resident Vosk in the frozen combined loop
combined_runs.single_changed_variable: audio model/runtime: whisper.cpp small multilingual -> resident Vosk Small Spanish 0.42

answers.audio_correctness: All 9/9 selected commands were exact/equivalent and all 9 returned under concurrent load in 390-750 ms.
answers.availability: Six transcripts arrived before the next FR dispatch; E04 wait missed the immediate next dispatch by 109 ms but was used from the following dispatch; terminal STOP in E01 and E04 had no later FR dispatch before the 30 s boundary.
answers.fr_following: FR followed forward cues only superficially in E01 (MOVE). It ignored correct wait/stop cues: E04 emitted LEFT while six dispatches contained 'espera un segundo'; E06 emitted MOVE for three dispatches containing 'quieto' and three containing 'espera un segundo'.
answers.mission_behavior: Not improved overall. E01 gained accepted MOVE actions but still had no post-STOP dispatch. E04 changed from MOVE-only to LEFT-only without respecting wait/stop commands. E06 remained MOVE-only despite correct timely stop/wait transcripts.
answers.recommendation_rationale: Vosk clears the latency/availability question on these episodes, but its isolated safety-command misses and unchanged FR non-compliance make adoption premature. A separately authorized next test should target FR command precedence rather than another ASR candidate.
